channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: Police seize robot that groped 16-year-old girl, investigate whether young men were at the controls

item.title: New York man shot by ICE officers appears in immigration court
item.description: A New York man shot and wounded by federal immigration officers while driving with his young son has appeared before an immigration judge in Manhattan

item.title: More roller coasters shut down as authorities investigate fatal fall at Georgia amusement park
item.description: A Georgia amusement park where a man fell to his death from a roller coaster is set to reopen amid a growing safety probe of roller coasters made by the same manufacturer

item.title: FACT FOCUS: Social media posts falsely claim ballots marked by a poll worker will be disqualified
item.description: As early voting begins in the 2026 midterm elections, social media users are warning each other about what could allegedly happen if a poll worker marks a ballot before it is fed into a scanner

item.title: Jalen Hurts sidelined by a blood clot, the latest bad news in a rough season for the Eagles
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles have ruled out quarterback Jalen Hurts for Sunday's game against Carolina because of a superficial blood clot

item.title: Broncos beat the Seahawks 17-14 in OT on Ja'Quan McMillian's pick, Wil Lutz's 53-yarder
item.description: Ja’Quan McMillian intercepted Sam Darnold’s pass in overtime and Wil Lutz kicked a 53-yard field goal that gave the Denver Broncos a 17-14 victory over the Seattle Seahawks

item.title: Packers running back Josh Jacobs sues to have evidence in his battery case permanently sealed
item.description: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs has filed a lawsuit in an attempt to have evidence in his battery case permanently sealed

item.title: US businessman whose firm invested in European soccer clubs pleads guilty to fraud
item.description: An American businessman whose firm invested in several European soccer clubs that struggled under its ownership has pleaded guilty to fraud charges in New York

item.title: BBC asks judge to force Trump to sit for deposition in his own lawsuit against the channel
item.description: Lawyers for the BBC say that President Donald Trump is trying to delay sitting for a deposition in the defamation case he brought against the British broadcaster until January 2027

item.title: California orders lenders to report on handling of insurance payouts to LA fire survivors
item.description: California officials are ordering mortgage lenders to report on how they've handled insurance payouts to survivors of the 2025 Los Angeles-area fires

item.title: Russia strikes 9 Ukrainian regions as strain grows between Zelenskyy and Trump
item.description: Russian attacks on nine regions of Ukraine have caused emergency power outages and damaged homes, wounding at least 15 people

item.title: Ukraine abandons truce and attacks Russian oil refinery as Zelenskyy says he feels betrayed by Trump
item.description: Ukraine attacked a Russian oil refinery, abandoning a brief truce involving energy-related targets that it said Moscow did not heed

item.title: Drone strike and fire on ship in Romanian waters raise fears that war in Ukraine is spreading
item.description: Romanian authorities have launched search and rescue operations off the Black Sea coast after a drone struck a ship, causing it to catch fire

item.title: China moves to curb tech exports, including AI, citing national security risks
item.description: China plans to restrict or ban exports of 40 technologies, including AI, chips, and solar power, as its tech race with countries like the U.S. intensifies

item.title: States sue AI giant OpenAI, saying its popular chatbot is hurting children and deceiving adults
item.description: Eight states are suing the artificial intelligence giant OpenAI, saying the company’s popular chatbot violated consumer protection laws by hurting children and deceiving adults

item.title: Police seize robot that groped 16-year-old girl, investigate whether young men were at the controls
item.description: German authorities have opened an investigation into possible sexual harassment involving a robot
